description: Swapped the arguments in isAssignableFrom, checking if requestedType is assignable from clazz instead of clazz being assignable from requestedType, breaking the hierarchy check direction.
Changed the null-check operator on result in read() from '!=' to '==', causing a NullPointerException when result is null instead of safely returning null.
Replaced the logical AND operator (&&) with logical OR (||) in the type verification check during read(), so it fails incorrectly or skips validation.
Negated the isInstance check condition in read() by removing the exclamation mark, meaning it throws an exception when the type *is* correct and passes when it's wrong.
Replaced requestedType with clazz in the runtime type verification inside read(), checking against the base class instead of the specific requested subtype.
